help.text:
Usage: {bin} [options]

Options:
  -p, --port <port>   Port to run the server (default: {port})
  -H, --host <host>   Host to bind (default: {host})
  -n, --no-browser    Don't open browser automatically
  -l, --log           Show server logs (default: hidden)
  -t, --tray          Run in system tray mode (background)
  --no-tray           Don't create a tray icon (keep serving)
  --skip-update       Skip auto-update check
  -h, --help          Show this help message
  -v, --version       Show version

Commands:
  xai video --prompt "..." --output video.mp4
                      Generate a Grok Imagine video via the running gateway
                      (see: {bin} xai video --help)
  doctor [--json] [--port <port>]
                      Diagnose this install — versions, stale server, DB driver,
                      runtime deps, port (read-only)
launcher.networkExposed: ⚠ Network-exposed: reachable at {url} (bound 0.0.0.0). Use --host 127.0.0.1 for local-only.
launcher.trayReady: 💡 Router is now running in system tray. Close this terminal if you want.
launcher.trayReadyHint: Right-click tray icon to open dashboard or quit.
launcher.pressEnterBack: Press Enter to go back to menu...
launcher.switchingToTray: ⏳ Switching to tray mode... (icon already visible in menu bar)
launcher.closeTerminalHint: 💡 You can close this terminal. Right-click tray icon to quit.
launcher.startingBackground: ⏳ Starting background process... (tray icon will appear in ~3s)
launcher.crashedDisablingMit: ⚠️  Server crashed {count} times. Disabling MIT and restarting...
launcher.staleServerKilled: 🔁 A server from a different build is still running (running v{running}; disk has v{disk}) — stopping it so the new build can take the port.
launcher.staleServerNoPid: ⚠️ A server from a different build (v{running}) is holding the port, but there is no PID file to stop it safely — starting anyway. If startup fails, quit the other instance and retry.
launcher.trayUnavailable: Tray icon unavailable ({error}). The server keeps running without it.
launcher.traySkipped: Tray icon disabled. The server keeps running in the background.
doctor.title: 10router doctor — {version}, port {port}
doctor.help:
Usage: 10router doctor [options]

Diagnose this installation: versions, leftover servers, DB driver,
runtime dependencies, port and data dir. Read-only — it never installs,
repairs, restarts or kills anything.

Options:
  --json              Machine-readable report (stable schema)
  -p, --port <port>   Port to inspect (default: 20128)
  -h, --help          Show this help

Exit code is 1 when any check is red, 0 otherwise.
doctor.summaryRed: Found {red} problem(s) and {yellow} warning(s). The lines marked ❌ are the ones to act on.
doctor.readOnlyHint: Read-only: nothing was changed by this command.
doctor.version.no-server-version: version: something answers on port {port} but does not report 10router's version
doctor.version.mismatch: version mismatch: launcher {launcher}, on disk {disk}, serving {server}
doctor.stale-process.ok: no leftover server: nothing on port {port} is serving a different build
doctor.stale-process.unverified: a pidfile records pid {pidFilePid} but nothing on port {port} reports a version — cannot confirm it is stale
doctor.stale-process.no-marker: no version marker at {file}: a still-running old build cannot notice the disk moved on (serving {server}, launcher {disk})
doctor.stale-process.stale: stale build: port {port} serves {server} while the disk holds {disk} — restart to pick up the new build
doctor.stale-process.pid-mismatch: pidfile records {pidFilePid} but port {port} is owned by {owners}
doctor.build.missing-files: incomplete build in {dir}: missing {missing} — the last upgrade did not finish
doctor.build.no-version: build in {dir} has no readable package.json — reinstall
doctor.build.version-mismatch: build on disk is {version} but the launcher is {launcher} — a half-finished upgrade
doctor.driver.no-health: database: no /api/health answer — the server is not running, or is too old to report a driver
doctor.driver.no-driver: database: no driver and no runtime copy of better-sqlite3. Last driver error: {error}
doctor.driver.not-initialized: database: no driver yet — normal, /api/health never opens the DB, so this fills in on the first query
doctor.driver.fallback: database: using fallback {driver} — a preferred driver was skipped: {error}
doctor.runtime-deps.ok: runtime deps: installed and registered in {dir}
doctor.runtime-deps.no-runtime: runtime deps: {dir} does not exist yet — it is created on first start
doctor.runtime-deps.unregistered: runtime deps: {orphaned} installed in {dir} but absent from its package.json — the next npm install there will delete them
doctor.runtime-deps.missing: runtime deps: not installed in {dir}: {missing} (the fallback covers this)
doctor.runtime-deps.broken-artifact: runtime deps: {broken} is installed in {dir} but unusable — the compiled artifact it needs is missing, and npm still reports it as installed. Reinstall it (or delete {dir}/node_modules and restart).
doctor.port.ok: port {port}: free, or owned by this install
doctor.port.orphan-pidfile: port {port} is free, but {file} still records pid {pidFilePid}
doctor.port.foreign: port {port} is held by another process (pid {owners})
doctor.tray.missing: tray: systray2 is not installed — headless serving still works
doctor.data-dir.missing: data dir {dir} does not exist yet — created on first start
doctor.data-dir.legacy-pending: legacy 9Router data is still at {legacy} — it is migrated into {dir} on the next start
